supersede_policy: the raw run output is retained unedited; this file corrects one auto-assigned label and adds nothing to the measurements
registered_gate_outcome_detail: G1 passes; G2-G5 are all directionally positive with one-sided LCB95 well above zero, but their point estimates fall below the preregistered 0.02 absolute-AP effect size. The threshold was frozen before any model existed and is NOT relaxed. Statistical significance does not override a preregistered practical-effect requirement.

autolabel_correction.cause: a decision-logic defect in s7_run.py: it mapped 'G2 did not pass' directly to the ligand-shortcut verdict. G2 can fail on effect size while the contrast is strongly directional, which is exactly what happened.

contradicting_evidence.reading: ligand-only sits barely above prevalence and B4 is over five times ligand-only; the model is not exploiting a ligand-only shortcut

autolabel_correction.corrected_terminal_note: this label did not exist in the registered verdict set, which was incomplete: it had no term for 'directionally identified with lower bound above zero but below the practical threshold'. Adding a descriptive label does NOT convert the outcome into a pass. The Gate outcome remains FAIL_CLOSED.

trainability_control.reading: the identical pipeline recovers a known function of the frozen inputs decisively, so optimisation and the objective are NOT the defect

split.ligand_closure: held-out A is exact-ligand-graph disjoint from train; held-out B additionally scaffold-disjoint

identifiability_reading.correct_protein_required: YES - substituting a wrong protein collapses B4 from 0.022949 to 0.004851, i.e. essentially back to the ligand-only level. Almost all of B4's advantage over ligand-only requires the correct protein.
identifiability_reading.residue_order_required: YES - motif shuffle collapses B4 to 0.005296
identifiability_reading.correct_ligand_required: PARTIALLY - wrong ligand collapses B4 to 0.007682, above ligand-only but far below B4
identifiability_reading.ligand_only_shortcut: NOT PRESENT - ligand-only is 0.004499 against a prevalence of 0.002501
identifiability_reading.conclusion: the constraint-2 identifiability requirement is satisfied in DIRECTION on every control; it is the preregistered effect SIZE that is not met

heldout_B_robustness.reading: the scaffold-strict stratum reproduces the same ordering and magnitude; the result is not an artifact of ligand-scaffold overlap

registered_escalation_rule_fired.rule: PREREG section 7: B5 is authorised only if B4-BL fails G2, OR B4-BL passes but B4 macro-AP remains below 0.10
registered_escalation_rule_fired.why_this_satisfies_constraint_9: parsimony forbids a larger encoder unless prior experiments explicitly indicate missing information. That evidence now exists and is measured: the explicit non-PLM residue representation yields correct-protein, order-dependent, partner-sensitive signal, but only 0.0229 macro-AP. The residue representation is the binding constraint, so a frozen PLM is the indicated and preregistered next arm.

failure_localization.data: NOT the cause - the corpus is hash-verified and deterministically reproduced
failure_localization.closure: NOT the cause - 196 inference components, largest 15.2%, ligand-disjoint from train
failure_localization.optimization: NOT the cause - the trainability control recovers a known function at 0.759 macro-AP
failure_localization.identifiability_support: NOT the cause - all five contrasts have lower bounds above zero
failure_localization.representation: THE CAUSE - the explicit non-PLM residue features carry real but weak protein information
failure_localization.transfer: NOT TESTED - the confirmation cohort remains sealed

what_is_NOT_claimed: that sequence-plus-2D inputs lack the required information
that a ligand-only shortcut is present
any affinity, ranking or few-shot result
anything about the sealed confirmation cohort
next_action_authorised_by_preregistratio: train B5 with frozen esm2_t33_650M_UR50D, identical head, rank, sampler, budget and evaluation mask; B5 must satisfy G1-G5 plus G6 (B5-B4 >= 0.02, LCB95 > 0). The confirmation cohort stays sealed regardless of B5's outcome, and publication/time closure (R0R-3) is still unbuilt.
